about.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of bots with your own subscription (e.g. Claude Code, Grok, Agy, Codex). Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

name: v1.4.271
body: Following [1.4.269](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.269), here is the next round of Orca. Bots reach Qwen Code and span your paired computers, the phone app manages agents end to end, and chats get lighter and quicker. ## Bots across computers, a phone that runs your agents & snappier chats ✨ One bot group can now hold bots from your paired computers, bots can run on Qwen Code, chats can be deleted and continue on their own after a usage limit, and the phone app can share, import and connect agents without the desktop. - 🤖 **Bots across computers and agents:** One bot group can hold bots from paired computers, bots can run on Qwen Code, and group rooms hand follow-up turns to every member an agent @mentions. - 📱 **Run agents from your phone:** Edit an agent's automations, connect Slack, Linear, GitHub, Google and Composio, share an agent by link, import one from OpenClaw or Hermes, read its soul and manage its memory and skills, and hand a history session to another agent. These need the matching mobile build. - 💬 **Calmer chats:** Delete a chat, continue after a usage limit by default, list folders in the @ menu, and see quieter rows and a composer that keeps its welcome text clear. - 🐧 **Steadier Windows and WSL:** WSL hosts count working agents for keep-awake, Codex accounts and settings behave on WSL, and moving a folder to a WSL host asks first. - ⚡ **Lighter all around:** Terminal title changes, agent status updates, bot lists and phone refreshes stop rescanning or rebuilding everything, and hidden animations pause. - 🐙 **More than one GitHub account:** Link several GitHub accounts, with leaner link previews and comment polling. ## About Orca Bots (Beta) Orca Bots work like first-class teammates: they now span your computers, remember what they finished, and pick up where a usage limit or restart cut them off. - **Qwen Code behind your bots:** Qwen Code joins the agents a bot can run on. - 🖥️ **One group, many computers:** A bot group can hold bots from paired computers, and an agent's answer to a peer's request shows in the room. - 📓 **Memory that keeps up:** Bots journal each closed item and its PRs, know that work state lives in Items and the journal, and a pilot Tidy-up moves and merges memory lines instead of rewriting them. - 🔁 **Picks up where it left off:** After a restart or a usage-limit pause, bots keep their open requests and continue them once. - 💬 **Easier replies:** Item comment boxes get the composer's mention and slash pickers, and "Replying to" jumps to the question it answers. ## Known issue - ⚠️ **Bots can pause their work:** After the app restarts, or after an error such as hitting a usage limit, a bot can stop partway through its work. This will be fixed in the next version. ## Coming soon - Antigravity bug fixes - More connectors - Easier moving of bots between different machines - More performance improvements - Fix bots stall issues under heavy task load - Improved PR review workflow - More plugin API - Sidebar UX improvements --- ## What's Changed ### 🤖 Bots, connectors & access *Bots can run on Qwen Code and one group can hold bots from paired computers, bots journal closed items and keep requests across restarts and usage-limit pauses, and item comments get the composer's pickers.* * Flash the open chat when its sidebar row is pressed again by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/44870 * Bot Items list: fetch only what changed, and never re-fetch loaded Closed pages by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/45990 * A restart continuation claims the requests its cut left open, and settles each once by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46068 * A usage-limit pause keeps its requests for the automatic continue, and closes them once none will come by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46080 * Let bots run on Qwen Code by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46109 * Show a managed agent's answer to a peer's request in the room by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46117 * A comment sent with its reply mark closed answers no question by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46161 * Give Activity cards a visible edge in dark theme by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46167 * Open the comment box four lines tall while replying to a question by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46168 * Offer this Mac's Slack token first when a remote computer's token expired by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46174 * NO_REPLY can't silence a bot's real answer to a Slack DM by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46182 * One bot group can hold bots from paired computers by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46196 * Refuse a bot delete while its home has unsaved editor drafts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46207 * Keep newer-agent bot hooks out of webhook-host.json so a rollback cannot delete their live URLs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46209 * Send bot automation create to the picked bot's host when hosts share a bot ID by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46214 * Item comment
